mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5%, it indicates monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS > 2.5% periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) reflects weakening consumer demand, which lowers corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS occurs but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of such instances over the next 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market tightness that may trigger inflation and central bank tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, the unemployment rate falls but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of such instances over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in rising PAYEMS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals an overheating labor market that may prompt aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE falls below 3.5%, S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of instances over the next 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a contraction in the real economy, reducing corporate earnings and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and GDPC1 occurs but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of such instances over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: In early-stage recessions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals a deepening economic downturn, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In early-stage recessions, INDPRO falls below 12-month moving average but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of instances over the next 5 days.
